manifest.notes: Sepolia native ETH/TIER pool: currency0 is native ETH and currency1 is TIER. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96, equal to 10000 * 2^96, representing 100000000 TIER per ETH with 18 decimals on both sides. This matches test/helpers/LaunchParameters.sol and the local factory-shaped one-sided TIER seed rehearsal, including both first-buy modes into an ETH-less pool. The pool LP fee is 3000 pips (0.3%), separate from the hook fee. LoyaltyTierHook takes only the approved Sepolia PoolManager address; TIER takes no constructor arguments. The four permissions give address mask 0x00cc; all other permissions are false and the constructor validates them. Lifetime ETH-leg volume is uint128 per pool and identity. Fees use pre-swap volume: 100 bps below 0.01 ETH, 75 bps from 0.01 ETH, 50 bps from 0.1 ETH and 25 bps from 1 ETH, with inclusive thresholds. ETH-specified swaps return a positive specified fee delta in beforeSwap; ETH-unspecified swaps return a positive unspecified fee delta in afterSwap. Fees round down, specified amounts are honored exactly and partial fills revert. Identity requires exactly 32 canonical ABI bytes encoding a nonzero address equal to tx.origin; otherwise the swap pays 100 bps and adds no volume. hookData is unauthenticated; the origin check only confirms a pricing claim. Relayed or bundled smart-contract wallets naming their wallet address earn no discount. Non-native currency0 pools receive zero hook deltas and no volume updates. Swap callbacks mint ERC-6909 ETH claims without transferring ETH. Permissionless burnFees burns all claims before taking ETH to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD. Callbacks require the configured PoolManager; the hook has no admin or mutable rates. Views expose volume, tier, fee and next threshold; VolumeAdded reports the updated tier. This is a technical manifest; deployment policy and signed artifact linkage belong to services. Local rehearsal does not establish production-factory equivalence, independent review, admission or deployment. Tiers is a Sepolia test toy with no value or promised return.

abiInstructions: Build ABIs from this exact source commit; compare canonicalKeccak(abi) with abiHash. Verify deployed code on the stated chain before enabling transactions.
